newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Islamic bank loans Morocco's private sector $10 mln.
newsitem.headline: Islamic bank loans Morocco's private sector $10 mln.

text.p: The Saudi Arabia-based Islamic Development Bank (IDB), looking at a possible $1 billion fund to invest in members' private sectors, on Tuesday granted Morocco's Wafabank a $10 million loan.
The $10 million loan is to be made available to the private sector to cover imports of crude oil, industrial equipment and raw materials.

"So far the bank has invested in Morocco's big companies but from now on we would like it to show interest for small and medium firms," said Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj who attended the signing ceremony.
IDB president President Ahmed Mohamed Ali said the bank was considering setting up a $1 billion fund to invest in the private sectors of member countries.
"We are studying the possibility of setting up a $1 billion fund to help the structure of member countries' private sector," he said.
At an earlier meeting with the Moroccan finance minister, the IBD president said the bank was determined to support the avant-garde role of the private sector in economic development.
